thread:
rachel: FYI — found ~250 leads between 00:05-00:25 that never hit sales assignment. Looks like enrichment stalled again. Anyone awake? :coffee:

omar: saw an enrichment vendor alert at 00:15 (latency spike). Webhooks retried and some requests hit the TTL.

claire: our RR claim window is 30s; p95 enrichment for that window = 95s. That explains it.

ben: short-term: flip routing deadline to 80s for the 00:00-03:00 window and spin up a one-off backfill. I can do both.

devops-bot: Enrichment service latency alert: p95 > 60s observed 2024-08-04T00:12Z-00:17Z. Incident ticket created: INC-8742.

rachel: please also add a HubSpot hold rule to prevent RR firing until `enrich_state` == ready. We don't want duplicates.

omar: adding HS workflow: if property `enrich_state` == pending then set `lifecycle_stage` = processing. Pushing now.

claire: backfill plan: 1) query unassigned leads in time window 2) POST to enrich idempotently 3) enqueue to rr if enrichment returns or after 90s move to overflow pool. Ben, ETA?

ben: backfill running now. Job id bf-20240804-01. Will update counts when done.

rachel: messaging for sales (short): "Late-night enrichment delays affected a small number of leads; ops reprocessed them and assignment restored. No lost data. DM if you notice anything missing."

devops-bot: Backfill job completed: processed 248 leads -> 223 assigned to RR, 25 sent to overflow. No duplicates detected.

omar: keeping the routing deadline extended for the night; will revert at 08:00 unless further issues. Leaving a ticket for eng to make enrichment async and to add p95 alerts tied to routing SLA.

claire: filing postmortem draft. Will attach telemetry and list long-term fixes: async enrich, dynamic claim window, HS hold rule as default for night windows.

rachel: thanks all — closing thread after postmortem link added. :white_check_mark:
